title: A password checker
description:
Check a password against a set of rules, with one small function per rule.

```
Password: hunter2
Too short (at least 10 characters)
Needs an upper-case letter
Needs a symbol
Strength: 2 of 5
```
hints: Each rule can loop over the characters and `return True` as soon as one matches (for example `ch.isupper()`), with `return False` after the loop. A symbol is a character that is neither `isalpha()` nor `isdigit()`.
requirements: Five rules: at least 10 characters, a lower-case letter, an upper-case letter, a digit, a symbol (any character that is not a letter or digit).
Write each rule as a function that returns `True` or `False`.
`check(password)` returns a list of messages for the rules that fail. Print each, then the strength.
If every rule passes, print `Strong password` instead of the messages.
stretch: Keep the rules in a list of `(function, message)` pairs and loop over it, so adding a rule is one line.
